fact: The Garden of Welcome is located on a plateau higher than the rest of the grove.
source_quote: The Garden of Welcome was a nightmare made real. The plateau rose high above the rest of the grove
subject: Garden of Welcome

fact: The Garden of Welcome is screened by towering zurkhwood stalks.
source_quote: screened by towering zurkhwood stalks
subject: Garden of Welcome

fact: The Garden of Welcome emits a chorus of muffled moans, cries, and hisses.
source_quote: from within came a chorus of muffled moans and cries
subject: Garden of Welcome

fact: The Garden of Welcome is illuminated only by a few glowing mushrooms.
source_quote: Only a few glowing mushrooms illuminated the gloom
subject: Garden of Welcome

fact: The Garden of Welcome contains the heads of creatures from a dozen Underdark races peeking from the soil.
source_quote: the heads of creatures from a dozen different Underdark races peeked from the soil
subject: Garden of Welcome

fact: Xinaya is a drow woman with a face half-rotted and blooming with tiny fungi.
source_quote: a drow woman named Xinaya, her face half-rotted and blooming with tiny fungi
subject: Xinaya

fact: Xinaya raises a spider medallion embedded in the fungal mass that was once her hand.
source_quote: raised a spider medallion embedded in the fungal mass that had once been her hand
subject: spider medallion

fact: Xinaya begs the party to end her suffering.
source_quote: She begged the party in desperate, broken words to end her suffering
subject: Xinaya

fact: Xinaya warns that Zuggtmoy, the Lady of Decay, is present.
source_quote: warned that Zuggtmoy, the Lady of Decay, was present
subject: Zuggtmoy

fact: Xinaya was sent by Ilvara to search for and capture the party near the grove.
source_quote: she had been sent by Ilvara to search for and capture them near the grove
subject: Ilvara

fact: Ilvara reserved the privilege of killing the fugitives for herself.
source_quote: Ilvara had reserved the privilege of killing the fugitives for herself
subject: Ilvara

fact: Xinaya and her patrol accepted Phylo's invitation to visit the Garden of Welcome.
source_quote: She and her patrol had made the fatal mistake of accepting Phylo's invitation to visit the Garden of Welcome
subject: Xinaya's patrol accepting invitation

fact: Phylo invited Xinaya and her patrol to visit the Garden of Welcome.
source_quote: accepting Phylo's invitation to visit the Garden of Welcome
subject: Phylo

fact: Xinaya recognizes Daz as being from Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: Xinaya recognizes Daz as being from Menzoberranzan
subject: Daz

fact: Xinaya urges Daz to warn the other Drow that the Demon Queen of Fungi has entered the Underdark.
source_quote: She urged Daz... to warn the other Drow that the Demon Queen of Fungi had entered the Underdark
subject: warning to Drow

fact: Yestabrod is a larval creature with vestigial fungal growths suggesting it might once have been a myconid.
source_quote: A disgusting larval creature named Yestabrod rises from the ground, its vestigial fungal growths suggesting that it might once have been a myconid
subject: Yestabrod

fact: Yestabrod speaks both aloud and inside the party's minds.
source_quote: It welcomed the party to a wedding rehearsal in a gurgling voice heard both aloud and inside their minds
subject: Yestabrod

fact: Yestabrod welcomes the party to a wedding rehearsal.
source_quote: It welcomed the party to a wedding rehearsal
subject: wedding rehearsal announcement

fact: Two adult myconids emerge to join Yestabrod.
source_quote: Two adult myconids and drow spore servants from Xinaya's former patrol emerged to join it
subject: myconids

fact: Drow spore servants from Xinaya's former patrol emerge to join Yestabrod.
source_quote: drow spore servants from Xinaya's former patrol emerged to join it
subject: drow spore servants

fact: Yestabrod rejects the party's attempt to use their audit ploy, stating there will be no audit.
source_quote: Yestabrod rejected the ploy: there would be no audit, only incorporation into the “coworkers of pain.”
subject: audit refusal

fact: The party enters the Garden of Welcome through Rumpadump's secret route.
source_quote: The party enters through Rumpadump's secret route before Phylo can conduct his planned tour the following morning
subject: secret entry

fact: Rumpadump has a secret route into the Garden of Welcome.
source_quote: The party enters through Rumpadump's secret route
subject: Rumpadump
